articles.summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (InvenTrust or the Company) today announced the acquisition of River Oaks, a 275,000 square foot grocery-anchored center located in a premier San Fernando Valley sub-market of Los Angeles, CA, for approximately $115 million. This Smart News Release features multimedia. View the full release here: http://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20170918005315/en/ InvenTrust Properties Corp. acquires River Oaks, a 275,000 square foot grocery-ancho
articles.title: InvenTrust Properties Corp. Announces Acquisition of River Oaks in Valencia, CA
